records.label: AI Connect on / off (MCP server)
records.notes: Turning it off disconnects every client. Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiConnect.php, AiConnectScreen.php.

records.label: Allow AI to change settings
records.notes: Off: read-only tools only; on: mutating Abilities are exposed. Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/McpServer.php exposed().

records.label: Client to connect (Claude, ChatGPT, Claude Code, Claude Desktop, Cursor, VS Code, Windsurf, Gemini, other)
records.notes: Per-client setup snippet and config file. Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiConnect.php CLIENTS.

records.label: Per-client Application Password session
records.notes: One WordPress Application Password per connection, shown once. Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiConnect.php.

records.label: Connector link sign-in for Claude and ChatGPT
records.notes: Paste the server URL, then Allow on the site. Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiConnect.php LINK_CLIENTS.

records.label: Connected clients list
records.notes: Lists active sessions with client and last use. Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiConnectScreen.php.

records.label: Disconnect a client
records.notes: Revokes the session credential immediately. Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiConnectScreen.php op=revoke.

records.label: OAuth protected resource metadata (/.well-known/oauth-protected-resource)
records.notes: Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiOAuth.php resourceMetadata(). Standard: RFC 9728.

records.label: OAuth authorization server metadata (/.well-known/oauth-authorization-server)
records.notes: Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiOAuth.php serverMetadata(). Standard: RFC 8414.

records.label: Dynamic client registration (bounded, 100 clients)
records.notes: Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiOAuth.php registerClient(). Standard: RFC 7591.

records.label: Authorization code with PKCE and an on-site consent screen
records.notes: Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiOAuth.php authorize(), consent(). Standard: OAuth 2.1 draft.

records.label: Redirect URIs limited to HTTPS or loopback
records.notes: Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiOAuth.php redirectAllowed().

records.label: MCP initialize and tools/list over Streamable HTTP
records.notes: Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/McpServer.php. Standard: Model Context Protocol.

records.label: Tools generated from registered Abilities allowed on the AI channel
records.notes: Each module contributes tools without its own MCP code. Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/McpServer.php exposed().

records.label: site_info tool (site name, URL, versions, write mode)
records.notes: Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/McpServer.php siteInfo().

records.label: Per-call Ability authorization for the signed-in user
records.notes: Denied calls return "Not allowed" and are audited. Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/McpServer.php call().

records.label: Activity log (latest 50 calls on screen)
records.notes: Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiActivityLog.php PAGE_SIZE.

records.label: Activity log CSV download (up to 5,000 rows)
records.notes: Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/AiActivityLog.php EXPORT_LIMIT, CSV_COLUMNS.

records.label: Audit the built-in site_info tool too
records.notes: site_info is answered by the server itself and is not written to the log today; the screen says every call is audited.

records.label: Choose which tools each client may call
records.notes: Deferred: today the switch is all read tools, or all read and write tools. Market reference: WordPress MCP Adapter ability filters.

records.label: Rate limit MCP calls per client
records.notes: Deferred.

records.label: Session expiry and token rotation
records.notes: Deferred: sessions last until revoked.

records.label: MCP access without authentication
records.notes: Rejected: every call needs a user credential or OAuth token. Evidence: wpessential frameworks/Platform/Admin/Connect/McpServer.php.

records.label: Tools that run raw SQL or PHP
records.notes: Rejected: tools only call validated Abilities.

records.label: Tools that return licence keys, passwords or tokens
records.notes: Rejected.

coverage.notes: Discovery seed from the shipped AI Connect runtime (switches, clients, sessions, OAuth 2.1, MCP, activity log) plus deferred controls and rejected unsafe patterns. Market sources are listed but not yet audited; native and market audits and a Bank review are the next stages.
